item.title: Modern CLI tools
item.description: The CLI tools ecosystem is very alive, I feel this trend restarted with the Go and Rust languages, for the best. I’ve used some CLI commands for multiple decades, it’s hard to force new habits, but some of those new tools really justify some efforts. This is a list of some I’ve adopted already or trying to adopt, obviously opiniated choices: Yazi Terminal file manager You can select multiple file with space then open them using enter.
